title: LoRA Forward and Merge
signature: def lora_forward_and_merge(x, W, A, B, alpha) -> tuple
hints: The rank r is A.shape[1]. The LoRA branch is scaled by alpha / r, not alpha.
Compute (x @ A) @ B rather than x @ (A @ B): the first never builds a d_in x d_out matrix.
Merging folds the same scaled update into the weight: W + (alpha / r) * A @ B. Then x @ W_merged equals y.
